format_notes: Takum logarithmic (Hunhold 2024, arXiv:2404.18603): value = exp(ell/2), exhaustive 256 codes, correctly-rounded f64. zero at 0x00; NaR at 0x80 (MSB-set); n<12 is below the nominal takum standard threshold (recorded, not a decoder error)

anchor_check.note: 3.0 is not an exact grid point of this format at this width

round_trip_policy: decode: exact bits->f64 (exhaustive). encode (reference): round-nearest-ties-even; overflow per format convention. abs_error 0 for representable values.
